items.label: GlobalWafers press release: release gwc-news-20261007 (10-07-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Group affiliate Sino-American Silicon's release on Taiwan Speciality Chemicals

set.signal: Sino-American Silicon's group release (on the GlobalWafers site), on its affiliate Taiwan Speciality Chemicals: AI and advanced-process demand has pushed disilane capacity utilization close to full, with expansion continuing; anhydrous hydrogen fluoride (AHF) is gradually being introduced into advanced logic, memory and HBM processes; the benefits of the Hong Jie Technology acquisition are gradually showing, with Hong Jie's cleaning and coating capacity expanding.

items.reason: The release calls Taiwan Speciality Chemicals the affiliate (related enterprise) of the Sino-American Silicon group; the entry wrongly called Sino-American Silicon the 'group affiliate'. Also keeps the release's 'gradually' hedge on the Hong Jie benefits.
items.evidence: 關聯企業方面，台特化（4772:TT）... 併購弘潔科技效益亦逐步顯現
